name: ntfyx
description: Public Topic notifications, rich task reports and verified encrypted phone replies for coding agents. Public sending needs explicit terms acceptance; protected questions use phone pairing.

interface.shortDescription: Phone replies for your coding agent
interface.longDescription: Keep a task’s updates and questions in one encrypted conversation. Answer with buttons or text on iPhone, Android or an authorized Web Inbox. Send Markdown, metrics, tables, progress and native charts from the CLI or local MCP. Includes a phone-first question skill. Claude Code also bridges AskUserQuestion; Codex native question prompts are not intercepted. Requires Ntfyx CLI 0.6.0+; protected messages and questions require phone pairing. Public Topic sends need explicit terms acceptance and support reports and local blocking. Tool execution approvals have a separate compatibility matrix.
defaultPrompt: Ask me a test question on my phone with Ntfyx.
Keep this task’s updates and questions in one Ntfyx Session.
